must_not: A step that needs a swipe or a long press, or a button that the keyboard cannot reach

steps.action: Tap 'New challenge'; fill 'Name', 'What counts', the goal, 'First day', 'How many days', 'Free days for everyone who reaches the goal'
user_sees: Sheet 'New challenge'
Hints 'Members see this name. At most 60 letters.', 'Today or a later day, up to 60 days from today.', 'From 7 to 31 days.', 'From 0 to 60. You check each winner before the days are added.'
A preview of what members will read
must_not: 'Fill in the boxes above to see what members will read.' left when all boxes are filled

steps.action: Save
user_sees: Toast 'Challenge saved. Members see it in the MettleUp app within 10 minutes.'
The challenge card with who has reached the goal
must_not: Two challenges that overlap
A second challenge from a double tap
Free days added before the owner checks a winner
A step that needs a swipe or a long press, or a button that the keyboard cannot reach

start: Staff online, Challenges; the owner runs a challenge

steps.action: Open Challenges

'Leaderboard · last 30 days'
must_not: 'New challenge', turn-on, change, cancel, give or skip controls for staff

steps.action: Do step 1 of "Challenges" in the panel on a phone, with the same login open in the panel on a laptop.
user_sees: The laptop shows the change after a refresh or by itself
must_not: The laptop saving over the phone's change with old values, or the two never agreeing
